text: What is a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account and is there a minimum balance requirement
What is BSBDA account, minimum balance rakhna padta hai kya
BSBDA account kya hota hai, minimum balance ki zarurat hai kya
BSBDA khaate mein minimum balance rakhna padta hai ya yeh zero balance account hota hai
Can I open more than one Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account in the same bank
Can I ek se zyada BSBDA account same bank mein khol sakta hoon
Ek bank mein ek se zyada BSBDA account khol sakte hain kya
Kya main ek hi bank mein do BSBDA khaata khol sakta hoon ya sirf ek hi milega
How many free withdrawals are allowed per month on a BSBDA account
BSBDA account mein monthly kitne free withdrawals milte hain
Ek mahine mein BSBDA se kitni baar free withdrawal kar sakte hain
BSBDA khaate mein mahine bhar mein kitni baar paisa nikalna free hota hai
Does checking my balance at an ATM count as one of the free withdrawals
ATM mein balance check karna free withdrawal mein count hota hai kya
ATM se balance check karne par kya woh withdrawal limit mein aata hai
Agar main ATM mein sirf balance dekhta hoon to kya woh withdrawal ginti mein aata hai
Is the ATM debit card provided free of cost with a BSBDA account
BSBDA account ke saath ATM card free milta hai kya
Kya BSBDA khaate mein ATM debit card bina charge ke milta hai
BSBDA khulwane par ATM card free milega ya uske liye alag se paisa dena hoga
Is there any age or income restriction for opening a BSBDA account
BSBDA account kholne ke liye koi age ya income limit hai kya
Kya BSBDA khaata kholne ke liye age ya income ki koi shart hoti hai
BSBDA khulwane ke liye kya koi umar ya kamai ki seema hoti hai
What is a BSBDA small account opened under simplified KYC and how long is it valid
Simplified KYC wala BSBDA small account kitne time ke liye valid hota hai
Small account jo simplified KYC se khulta hai woh kitne saal tak valid rehta hai
Simplified KYC se khula hua small account kitne mahine tak chalta hai aur extend ho sakta hai kya
Can my existing normal savings account be converted into a BSBDA account
Mera normal savings account BSBDA mein convert ho sakta hai kya
Kya mera purana savings account BSBDA mein badla ja sakta hai
Mera jo pehle se savings khaata hai use BSBDA mein tabdeel karwa sakta hoon kya
How much yearly financial benefit does the PM-KISAN scheme provide to farmers
PM-KISAN yojana mein farmers ko yearly kitna paisa milta hai
PM-KISAN yojana ke tahat kisano ko saal mein kitna paisa milta hai
PM-KISAN yojana mein kisan parivar ko ek saal mein kitna paisa milta hai aur kitni kisto mein milta hai
What are the eligibility criteria for a farmer family to receive PM-KISAN benefits
PM-KISAN ke liye eligibility criteria kya hai farmer family ke liye
PM-KISAN yojana ke liye kisan parivar ko kya sharte poori karni padti hain
PM-KISAN ka labh lene ke liye kisan parivar ko kaunsi sharte poori karni hoti hain
Are institutional landholders eligible for PM-KISAN benefits
Institutional landholders PM-KISAN ke liye eligible hain kya
Kya institutional landholders ko PM-KISAN ka fayda milta hai
Agar zameen kisi sanstha ke naam par hai to kya PM-KISAN ka labh milega
Which categories of people are excluded from PM-KISAN even if they own farmland
PM-KISAN se kaun kaun exclude hote hain agar unke paas zameen bhi ho
Zameen hone ke bawajood kaunse log PM-KISAN se exclude kiye jaate hain
Sarkari naukri wale ya pension paane wale kisan PM-KISAN ka labh le sakte hain kya
Is a linked Aadhaar number mandatory for receiving PM-KISAN payments
PM-KISAN payment ke liye Aadhaar link hona mandatory hai kya
Kya PM-KISAN ka paisa lene ke liye Aadhaar link karna zaroori hai
PM-KISAN ki kisht paane ke liye Aadhaar seeding zaroori hai kya aur mismatch hone par kya hota hai
Can farmers with agricultural land in urban areas receive PM-KISAN benefits
Urban area mein agricultural land wale farmers ko PM-KISAN milta hai kya
Shehri ilaake mein kheti ki zameen ho to kya PM-KISAN ka labh milta hai
Agar meri kheti ki zameen shehar ke andar hai to kya mujhe PM-KISAN ka paisa milega
How can a farmer apply for PM-KISAN online or through a Common Service Centre
PM-KISAN ke liye online apply kaise karein ya CSC se kaise karein
Kisan PM-KISAN ke liye registration online kaise kare ya CSC jaakar kaise kare
PM-KISAN mein naye kisan ka registration khud portal par karein ya CSC centre jaakar karwayein, dono tarike kaise hain
What is a bsbda account, is there any minimum balance requirement
kya bsbda khata zero balance account hota hai ya balance rakhna padega
Kya ek hi bank mein do bsbdaa account open kar sakte hain
How many free cash withdrawals can I make from a bsb-da account each month
atm me balance enquiry karne par monthly limit cut hoti hai kya
bsbda account holder ko atm debit card free milta hai ya annual charge lagta hai
kya bsbda khata khulwane par pasbook free di jaati hai
Can I open a small account using simplified kyc documentation
simplified kyc wala small acount kitne months tak valid rehta hai
How much financial benefit does pmkisan yojana provide to farmers annually
pm-kisaan yojana ka labh lene ke liye farmer family ki eligibility sharte kya hain
kya institutional landholder ko pmkisan scheme ka fayda milta hai
pmkisan payment aane ke liye aadhar link karwana mandatory hai kya
Agar adhar details mismatch ho jaye to kya pm-kisan ki kist ruk jayegi
kisan pmkisan registration ke liye common service center ya csc par kaise jayein
